title: Thomas Winterton's scalp separated from skull after digging

tellings.quote: >> One day, I decided to do some digging. And then, 3 days after, I noticed that I had a goose egg on the back of my head.

plain: A man named Thomas Winterton says that after he did some digging at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch famous for reports of strange events, his scalp came away from his skull. He tells Michels this himself: "three days after, I noticed that I had a goose egg on the back of my head," which he links to the digging, as if something on the land had harmed him.
